say:1:1736102001:1.text: Work is all she cares about! The windows at home have been broken for three months, and she just ignores them!
say:1:1736102001:1.source_cn: 你看看她！每天就知道工作、工作！家里的门窗坏了三个月都...
say:1:1736102001:1.male: Work is all she cares about! The windows at home have been broken for three months, and she just ignores them!
say:1:1736102001:1.female: Work is all she cares about! The windows at home have been broken for three months, and she just ignores them!

say:2:1736102002:1.text: Don't you dare criticize me! Who's putting food on the table? Me! While you spend all day fussing over your useless plants!
say:2:1736102002:1.source_cn: 你好意思说我？你整天就知道摆弄那些破花草，赚过一分钱吗...

say:3:1736102003:1.text: It's called gardening, and it's an art! You just don't get it! I'd rather turn into a hamster and be chased by cats all day than look at your poker face!
say:3:1736102003:1.source_cn: 那是园艺！是艺术！你不懂！我宁愿变成一只仓鼠，整天被猫...

say:4:1736102004:0.text: Do it! What are you waiting for? If you turn into a hamster, I'll throw you straight to the stray cats!
say:4:1736102004:0.source_cn: 变啊！你变啊！你要是变成仓鼠，我就把你扔野猫堆里面去！

choice_prompt:5:1736102004.text: Do it! What are you waiting for? If you turn into a hamster, I'll throw you straight to the stray cats!
choice_prompt:5:1736102004.source_cn: 变啊！你变啊！你要是变成仓鼠，我就把你扔野猫堆里面去！

say:9:1736102006:0.text: You use transfiguration and turn the couple into hamsters!
say:9:1736102006:0.source_cn: 你施放了变形术，把他们都一股脑变成了仓鼠！
say:9:1736102006:0.male: You use transfiguration and turn the couple into hamsters!
say:9:1736102006:0.female: You use transfiguration and turn the couple into hamsters!

say:10:1736102007:0.text: *Squeak* Wh-What just happened? Why am I so small? And where are my arms?!
say:10:1736102007:0.source_cn: 吱？这、这是什么？我怎么变小了？我的手呢？！

say:11:1736102008:0.text: *Squeak* Good grief, I have fur on my face! I've really turned into a hamster!
say:11:1736102008:0.source_cn: 吱吱！我的脸！我的毛！天哪，我真的变成了一只仓鼠！

choice_prompt:12:1736102008.text: *Squeak* Good grief, I have fur on my face! I've really turned into a hamster!
choice_prompt:12:1736102008.source_cn: 吱吱！我的脸！我的毛！天哪，我真的变成了一只仓鼠！

say:14:1736102010:0.text: I'm not working with him! I'll do this myself!
say:14:1736102010:0.source_cn: 我才不要和他合作！我要自己走！

narration:15:1736102011:1.text: As a stray cat inches closer, the two hamsters drop their bravado and join forces...

narration:16:1736102012:1.text: Once again, you appear before them after their perilous journey...
narration:16:1736102012:1.male: Once again, you appear before them after their perilous journey...
narration:16:1736102012:1.female: Once again, you appear before them after their perilous journey...

say:17:1736102013:0.text: Mimi, thank you... for pulling me to safety just now. I didn't know you were so strong.
say:17:1736102013:0.source_cn: 小美，刚才……谢谢你拉住了我。我没想到，你的力气居然这么大。

say:18:1736102014:0.text: Ugh, you weigh a ton... Though I have to admit, the way you blocked that stone was... kind of cool.
say:18:1736102014:0.source_cn: 哼，是你太重了……不过，你挡石头那一下，还挺……挺帅的。

choice_prompt:19:1736102014.text: Ugh, you weigh a ton... Though I have to admit, the way you blocked that stone was... kind of cool.
choice_prompt:19:1736102014.source_cn: 哼，是你太重了……不过，你挡石头那一下，还挺……挺帅的。

say:21:1736102015:1.text: You use transfiguration again to turn the hamsters into... a loving couple gazing into each other's eyes.
say:21:1736102015:1.source_cn: 你再次施展了变形术，将两只仓鼠变回了……一对正在深情对...
say:21:1736102015:1.male: You use transfiguration again to turn the hamsters into... a loving couple gazing into each other's eyes.
say:21:1736102015:1.female: You use transfiguration again to turn the hamsters into... a loving couple gazing into each other's eyes.

say:22:1736102016:1.text: Thank you, Magister! Without this adventure, I'd never have understood how much I took my marriage for granted...
say:22:1736102016:1.source_cn: 魔法师阁下，谢谢你！如果不是这次冒险，我都不知道自己错...
say:22:1736102016:1.male: Thank you, Magister! Without this adventure, I'd never have understood how much I took my marriage for granted...
say:22:1736102016:1.female: Thank you, Magister! Without this adventure, I'd never have understood how much I took my marriage for granted...

say:23:1736102017:1.text: I should thank you, too... for reminding me of what we saw in each other in the first place.
say:23:1736102017:1.source_cn: 我也要谢谢你，让我重新想起了当初我们为什么会在一起。
say:23:1736102017:1.male: I should thank you, too... for reminding me of what we saw in each other in the first place.
say:23:1736102017:1.female: I should thank you, too... for reminding me of what we saw in each other in the first place.

say:24:1736102018:1.text: We'll always be there for each other!
say:24:1736102018:1.source_cn: 我们会努力陪在彼此身边的！
say:24:1736102018:1.male: We'll always be there for each other!
say:24:1736102018:1.female: We'll always be there for each other!

choice:19:0:1.text: Looks like the love magic's working!
choice:19:0:1.male: Looks like the love magic's working!
choice:19:0:1.female: Looks like the love magic's working!

choice:19:1:2.text: Good, you two have patched things up!
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 你们已经和好如初了嘛
choice:19:1:2.male: Good, you two have patched things up!
choice:19:1:2.female: Good, you two have patched things up!

choice:12:0:1.text: Work together if you want to turn back.
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 想要变回去，就试着合作吧
choice:12:0:1.male: Work together if you want to turn back.
choice:12:0:1.female: Work together if you want to turn back.

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 一个人可面对不了眼前的困境

choice:7:0:1.text: Since you want to become hamsters so badly...
choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 既然你们这么想变成仓鼠——
choice:7:0:1.male: Since you want to become hamsters so badly...
choice:7:0:1.female: Since you want to become hamsters so badly...

choice:7:1:2.text: I'll make your wish come true!
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 那我就满足你们的愿望！
choice:7:1:2.male: I'll make your wish come true!
choice:7:1:2.female: I'll make your wish come true!

choice:5:1:2.text: You two need a little love magic!
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 你们需要爱之魔法的感化！
choice:5:1:2.male: You two need a little love magic!
choice:5:1:2.female: You two need a little love magic!
